decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template was announced publicly, sits close to the agency-focused hosting core, and costs little to maintain, so management sees no reason to withdraw it so soon after launch.
The responsive website template complements the hosting offer for agencies, and the firm has already invested in building it, which favors keeping it while adoption develops.
Premium support embodies the firm's announced strategy of round-the-clock expert, tailored support, so it is central to the firm's public identity and will be kept.
The version management tool reflects in-house development investment and has a dedicated page, and it fits the stated direction of tools that reduce recurring work, so the firm stays committed.

Although distant from the core, the data processing contract tool has its own page and serves GDPR needs of customers, so any weak uptake can be attributed to a temporary post-GDPR adjustment and the firm keeps it.
